title: Mark Bible Quiz - Chapter 9
description: Ten questions on Mark 9: the change on the high mountain, the boy with the mute spirit, the father's cry about his unbelief and the lesson on being servant of all.

questions.text: Whom did Jesus take up onto the high mountain?
questions.explanation: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John, and brought them up onto a high mountain privately.

answers.text: Andrew and Philip
All twelve disciples
The scribes who questioned him
Peter, James and John

questions.text: What happened to his clothing on the mountain?
questions.explanation: His clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten.

answers.text: It shone like a fire on the mountain
It became exceedingly white, like snow
It was torn in two from top to bottom
It turned the color of blood

questions.text: Who appeared and talked with Jesus?
questions.explanation: Elijah and Moses appeared to them, and they were talking with Jesus.

answers.text: Elijah and Moses
David and Isaiah
John the Baptizer
Two angels in white

questions.text: What did Peter suggest making on the mountain?
questions.explanation: Peter said it was good for them to be there and suggested making three tents: one for Jesus, one for Moses and one for Elijah.

answers.text: An altar of stones
A house of prayer
Three tents
A seat for each of them

questions.text: What did the voice out of the cloud say?
questions.explanation: A cloud came and overshadowed them, and a voice came out of the cloud, "This is my beloved Son. Listen to him."

answers.text: "Elijah has come first."
"Do not tell anyone what you saw."
"Rise up and do not be afraid."
"This is my beloved Son. Listen to him."

questions.text: What did the man from the multitude say about his son?
questions.explanation: He said he had brought his son, who has a mute spirit that throws him down so that he foams at the mouth, and that the disciples were not able to cast it out.

answers.text: He had been blind from childhood and could not see
He had a mute spirit the disciples could not cast out
He was lame in both feet and could not walk
He had a fever that no physician could cure

questions.text: What did the father of the child cry out with tears?
questions.explanation: He cried out, "I believe. Help my unbelief!"

answers.text: "Lord, let my son live!"
"Have compassion on us!"
"I believe. Help my unbelief!"
"Who then can be saved?"

questions.text: How did Jesus say this kind of spirit comes out?
questions.explanation: He said to his disciples, "This kind can come out by nothing, except by prayer and fasting."

answers.text: By prayer and fasting
By the laying on of hands
By anointing with oil
By the command of the twelve

questions.text: What did Jesus say to the twelve about wanting to be first?
questions.explanation: He sat down, called the twelve, and said that if any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.

answers.text: He shall be greatest in the Kingdom
He shall be last of all and servant of all
He shall sit at the right hand
He shall be sent out to preach

questions.text: What did Jesus say about salt at the end of his words?
questions.explanation: He said that salt is good, but if it loses its saltiness it cannot be seasoned again, and told them to have salt in themselves and be at peace with one another.

answers.text: Keep salt in a vessel in the house
Salt the fire of Gehenna
Give a cup of water in his name
Have salt in yourselves and be at peace
